brief.en: Click on banana, then a tile, to launch explosive banana
brief.zh: 点击后，选择一格发射爆炸香蕉子弹

description.en: Banana Launchers can fire explosive bananas at any tile on the lawn.
description.zh: 香蕉火箭炮能向场内任意一格发射一枚爆炸性香蕉子弹。

chat.en: It's important to avoid stereotyping as much as possible. Stereotypes are often flat-out wrong. And also hurtful. But honestly ... Banana Launcher is TOTALLY bananas.
chat.zh: 最好是消除刻板印象，刻板印象普遍是错误的，而且很伤人。但是实话实说，香蕉火箭炮完全就是个香蕉。

text.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
text.zh: 点击瞄准，再点击目标格子发射

text.en: on impact, explodes in small area
text.zh: 子弹爆炸时，对小范围造成巨大伤害
